attack_classification: Hybrid Campaign - Targeting and impersonation necessary (SEO poisoning / malvertising, AiTM)
targeting_evidence: The actor relied exclusively on geographic targeting of Canadian users, combined with socially engineering HR or finance staff members using consistent email subject lines across compromised users.
channels: Search engine (SEO poisoning/malvertising) > Corporate email > HR SaaS platform (Workday)
request: Change direct deposit details to redirect a payroll check to an attacker-controlled bank account
pretext: Setting up a new banking package and needing to update direct deposit instructions before the upcoming pay date
impact: Direct financial loss for affected individuals and organizations due to diverted salary payments
